import json, random, sys, collections
sys.path.insert(0, '/app/work'); sys.path.insert(0, '/app/submission')
import gen as G, ref as R, main as M

def run_case(name, force, n=40, seed=4242):
    dec = collections.Counter(); stat = collections.Counter(); mism = 0
    for it in range(n):
        rng = random.Random(seed * 7919 + it)
        doc = G.gen(rng, force)
        text = json.dumps(doc)
        root = json.loads(text, object_pairs_hook=M._hook_pairs,
                          parse_float=M._reject_float, parse_constant=M._reject_constant)
        st = M.validate(root)
        mine = M.replay(st); theirs = R.replay(st)
        if mine != theirs:
            mism += 1
            print("MISMATCH", name, it)
            open('/app/work/fail_%s.json' % name, 'w').write(text)
            for k in mine:
                if mine[k] != theirs[k]:
                    print(" key", k)
                    if k == "packets":
                        for i,(a,b) in enumerate(zip(mine[k],theirs[k])):
                            if a!=b: print("  pkt",i,a,b); break
                    elif k == "jobs":
                        for i,(a,b) in enumerate(zip(mine[k],theirs[k])):
                            if a!=b: print("  job",i,a,b); break
                    break
            return dec, stat
        for p in mine["packets"]: dec[p["decision"]] += 1
        for j in mine["jobs"]: stat[j["status"]] += 1
    print("%-10s dec:%-58s stat:%-40s mismatch:%d" % (name, dict(dec), dict(stat), mism))

run_case("starved", {"rate_num": 1, "rate_den": 1000, "bucket": 1, "npkt": 60, "idle": 1000})
